peak_seasons: Ashada Month (July/August) during Bonalu Jathara and Yellamma Kalyanotsavam
average_wait_time: 30 to 45 minutes on regular weekdays; 1 to 2 hours on peak days (Tuesdays/Fridays/Sundays)
peak_wait_time: 3 to 6+ hours during the annual Bonalu Jathara festival and Kalyanotsavam days
recommended_visiting_hours: 6:00 AM to 8:30 AM or 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM on Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays for a peaceful experience
crowd_management_notes: The temple draws large crowds on Sundays and Tuesdays in particular, and is highly crowded during the Bonalu Jathara celebrations. Severe traffic congestion occurs on Sundays, Tuesdays, and during the Bonalu festival, often prompting police to implement one-way traffic rules on Balkampet Road. A dedicated multi-level parking complex has been developed near the temple to manage visitor vehicles. Devotee numbers, queue waiting hours, and crowd estimates are not officially published by the temple administration.
